in_sanskrit.name: चिन्तमन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who possesses wisdom, intelligence, intellect.

in_hindi.name: चिन्तमन
in_hindi.meaning: चिन्ता (chintā) - thought, intelligence, intellect, mind मन (man) - mind, soul
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has a thoughtful, intelligent, and wise mind.

in_tamil.name: சிந்தமன்
in_tamil.meaning: சிந்தன (cinthaṉ) - thoughtful, intelligent, wise மன் (maṉ) - mind, soul
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has a thoughtful, intelligent, and wise mind.

in_telugu.meaning: చిన్న (chinna) - new, young, fresh మన�� (manu) - mind, soul
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has a new, young, and fresh mind.

in_marathi.name: Chintaman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Thought
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chintaman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chintaman is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'Chintana' meaning thought and 'Man' meaning mind or God. This name is believed to be a representation of Lord Ganesha, who is known as the God of Wisdom and Remover of Obstacles.
